fills.researcher_notes: Offshore-technology.com's Bahr Essalam field profile: gas from the field is treated on the Sabratha platform then piped to the onshore Mellitah plant via a 36in gas line (and condensate via a 10in line); operator is 'Mellitah Oil & Gas (MOG), a joint venture between Eni and National Oil Corporation (NOC)'. Independently, Mellitah Oil & Gas's own Sabratha Platform page (mellitahog.ly, a primary company source, distinct origin from the GlobalData trade profile) states the operator as 'Mellitah Oil & Gas B.V' and gives the same pipeline pair: a 36in gas line and 10in condensate line from Sabratha to Mellitah. High tier: two independent origins agree.

validity.recommendation: Flag for a human, not fixed here (out of my assigned flag scope, but surfaced during operator research): the sheet's Diameter=10 for this row matches the CONDENSATE line from Sabratha to Mellitah, not the 36in GAS line both sources describe -- worth checking whether this row is meant to represent the gas leg (in which case Diameter should likely read 36) or was intentionally scoped to the condensate leg. Also, sheet Capacity=465166 scm/y looks anomalously low next to the 986 MMSCFD (roughly 27.9 million scm/d) sales-gas figure Mellitah's own site gives for the whole Sabratha/Bahr Essalam system -- possible unit or order-of-magnitude error, worth a second look.
